app_fee.quote: To be considered for graduate study, you are required to pay a non-refundable $65 application fee. Your application fee can be paid within your admissions portal after you submit your application.

fee_waiver.value: Waivers available for current RIT students and RIT alumni
fee_waiver.quote: Current RIT students and RIT alumni are not required to pay the $65.00 application fee. The application fee will be waived within 24 hours of the submission of your application.

gre_general.value: Central graduate admissions does not set a campus-wide GRE requirement; requirements vary by academic degree program.
gre_general.quote: Test Scores (GRE/GMAT) varies by program Test Score Requirements Only some degrees require a GMAT (Graduate Management Admissions Test) or GRE (Graduate Record Examination).

toefl_min.value: Central graduate admissions does not set a single university-wide minimum TOEFL score; minimums are determined by each individual degree program in the deadlines and requirements table.
toefl_min.quote: View the overall minimum score requirement for your intended program in the graduate admission deadlines and requirements table.

ielts_min.value: Central graduate admissions does not set a single university-wide minimum IELTS score; minimums are determined by each individual degree program in the deadlines and requirements table.
ielts_min.quote: View the overall minimum score requirement for your intended program in the graduate admission deadlines and requirements table.

english_waiver.value: International applicants may be considered for a waiver if they have worked or studied in the U.S. for the last two years.
english_waiver.quote:
International Applicants may be considered for a waiver of an english language proficiency exam if:
They have worked or studied in the U.S. for the last two years
